lantern-maker in a flood city, far-future, rendered as pixel art concept art moodboard, warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows, wet terrazzo

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off. Lighting reference: blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
